title: Activate & Spend $X in 1 Transaction at Coles, Get 2,000 Bonus Flybuys Points @ Flybuys
body:
Deal: Activate & Spend $X in 1 Transaction at Coles, Get 2,000 Bonus Flybuys Points @ Flybuys

[8refund] Activate & Spend $X in 1 Transaction
what is the X please?
[noelhoi] What is the X ?
Well if you've got the flexibility, bend over and look between your legs, you'll find that X marks the spot
[Pauline Pants Down] Mine is spend $90 get 3600 points. Seems like 20% back in points.
[dyziplen] Managed to stack the 1st day of the 50/week for 10k points and last day of the 70 spend for 2800 points.
Then Aldi/Woolies and no more Coles til week 2.
[leeroys_dad] Stacking the one that ends today and the one that 'starts tomorrow' but still shows in my account - does that work?!
[HopSkipJumpFallSplat] Yes, as long as both have been activated.
[bluemyself] How can you activate the one that starts tomorrow though?
[leeroys_dad] Mine came via email today and shows '4 days left' but per the terms the start date is tomorrow
[choory] Not this time…🤨
Normally I get $60~90 / 2,000 points promotion with 4 week $?? / 10,000 points promotion together.
[bluemyself] Coles seems to really want me to keep shopping there. Got the $50/week deal. And got $70 for 2800 that ends today, and also got it again starting tomorrow.
So if I spend the minimum which would be $290 (one of the two $70 offers is stacked with weekly shop), I'd get 15600 pts ($78). 26.9% off
Oh and I'm using the recent 10% off Coles gift cards which I didn't include in the above.
[69dollars] I've got a save $20/$50, when you spend over $200/$350. I've never done a single $200 shop before lol.
[7bobas] I only got it on one account, 2 offers for $30 spend get 1,800 points, one expires today, one until tuesday. Happy with that
[DoctorCalculon] Does Coles glitch shopping still work with these type of offers? /cc @WookieMonster
[Ozzster] Mine is 10% discount if spent over 80, but discount can't be over 50. Stacks with first week out of 4, where all payments I'll make with gift cards bought with 10% discount.
[cpa2100] If I only purchase a gift card at Coles, would that transaction count towards the required spend?
